scripts.text:
[Rental Items Manager]
We offer various battlegears that you can use in the regions of Gloria and Kafragarten based on the rules of Siege Battle TE.

我们提供多种战斗装备，您可以按照攻城战TE的规则在格洛丽亚和卡普拉贾登地区使用。

scripts.text:
[Rental Items Manager]
^4d4dffWe provide 1-day rental periods for free.^000000
However, the provided rental items ^4d4dffwill not be effective outside the Siege Battle TE area.^000000

[租借物品管理员]
^4d4dff我们提供1天的免费租借期。^000000
但是，租借的物品^4d4dff在攻城战TE区域外无效。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rental Items Manager]
^4d4dffYou have to be Lv 40 or higher in order to rent an item.^000000
Select the desired equipment.
scripts.translation:
[租借物品管理员]
^4d4dff您的等级必须达到40级或以上才能租借物品。^000000
请选择您需要的装备。

scripts.text:
[Rental Items Manager]
Here is a list of rental items and descriptions.
scripts.translation:
[租借物品管理员]
这是租借物品列表及说明。

scripts.text:
[Rental Items Manager]
Come back anytime then.
scripts.translation:
[租借物品管理员]
随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text: We offer various battlegears that you can use in the regions of Gloria and Kafragarten based on the rules of Siege Battle TE.
scripts.translation: 我们提供多种战斗装备，您可以按照攻城战TE的规则在格洛丽亚和卡普拉贾登地区使用。

scripts.text:
[Rental Items Manager]
I'm sorry but your job class is not allowed to participate in Siege Battles TE.

scripts.text:

请整理您的物品后重试。
